# Theme country scope. Far-frontier loyalty relief when the theme's Praetorian Prefecture is active.
# T4 (-10 -> -5) and T3 (-5 -> 0) each receive +5 relief under an established Praetorian Prefecture.
oe_theme_emp_dist_prf_relief = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_distance
            OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 }
            oe_theme_pref_has_active_praetorian = yes
        }
        add = 5
    }
}

# IO scope (oe_byz_empire_pillars). Per-Prefecture summary metrics for the 4-Prefecture accordion UI.
oe_theme_ui_p1_count = {
    value = 0
    every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes } add = 1 }
}
oe_theme_ui_p1_loy_sum = {
    value = 0
    every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } add = var:oe_theme_loyalty }
}
oe_theme_ui_p1_avg_loy = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { any_international_organization_member = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } }
        value = oe_theme_ui_p1_loy_sum
        divide = {
            value = 0
            every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } add = 1 }
        }
    }
}
oe_theme_ui_p1_restless = {
    value = 0
    every_international_organization_member = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } var:oe_theme_loyalty < 40 } }
        add = 1
    }
}
oe_theme_ui_p1_creatable = {
    value = 0
    leader_country ?= {
        every_owned_location = { limit = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes var:oe_theme_prefecture ?= 1 } add = 1 }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Count of Eastern Exarchate groups E01-E10 ready for consolidation.
oe_theme_emp_exarchate_ready_count = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e1_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e2_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e3_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e4_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e5_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e6_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e7_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e8_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e9_ready = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e10_ready = yes } add = 1 }
}
